title: Films at home or at the cinema - which is better? 🍿 | Improve your listening with Real Easy English

sentences.en: Hi Phil.
sentences.ko: 안녕, 필.

sentences.en: Hi Georgie.
sentences.ko: 안녕, 조지.

sentences.en: How's your week going?
sentences.ko: 이번 주는 어떻게 지내고 있어?

sentences.en: It's going very well, thank you.
sentences.ko: 아주 잘 지내고 있어, 고마워.

sentences.en: I watched a really good film last night.
sentences.ko: 어젯밤에 정말 좋은 영화를 봤어.

sentences.en: Did you watch it at home or at the cinema?
sentences.ko: 집에서 봤어, 아니면 영화관에서 봤어?

sentences.en: I watched it at home on my sofa with my housemates.
sentences.ko: 집에서 하우스메이트들이랑 소파에 앉아서 봤어.

sentences.en: Oh, was it good?
sentences.ko: 오, 좋았어?

sentences.en: It was very good.
sentences.ko: 아주 좋았어.

sentences.en: Now, I told you I watched a film last night at home, but in this episode of Real Easy English, we're talking about cinema.
sentences.ko: 어젯밤에 집에서 영화를 봤다고 했는데, 이번 Real Easy English에서는 영화관에 대해 이야기할 거야.

sentences.en: So, the cinema is where you watch films, or in American English they're sometimes called movies.
sentences.ko: 영화관(cinema)은 영화(films)를 보는 곳인데, 미국 영어에서는 영화를 'movies'라고 부르기도 해.

sentences.en: And before we get started, let's just remind everyone that if you go to bbclearningenglish.com, there's a worksheet where you can practise all the language that you'll hear in this episode.
sentences.ko: 그리고 시작하기 전에 다시 알려드릴게요. bbclearningenglish.com에 가면 이번 에피소드에서 듣게 될 표현들을 모두 연습할 수 있는 워크시트가 있어요.

sentences.en: So, Phil, do you go to the cinema often?
sentences.ko: 그래서 필, 영화관에 자주 가?

sentences.en: No. No, I don't go very often at all.
sentences.ko: 아니. 아니, 전혀 자주 안 가.

sentences.en: What about you?
sentences.ko: 너는?

sentences.en: I don't go often, but I did go a couple of weeks ago.
sentences.ko: 자주는 안 가는데, 2주 전쯤에 갔었어.

sentences.en: I went to see an action film, a recent action film, and it was really spectacular.
sentences.ko: 최근에 나온 액션 영화를 보러 갔는데, 정말 장관이었어.

sentences.en: And I'm not a big fan of action movies – action films.
sentences.ko: 나는 액션 영화를 그렇게 좋아하진 않아.

sentences.en: I prefer films that are a bit less stressful, so I wouldn't usually watch action films at home, but in the cinema it was really an amazing experience because you have the big screen.
sentences.ko: 좀 덜 스트레스 받는 영화를 더 좋아해서, 집에서는 보통 액션 영화를 안 보는데, 영화관에서는 큰 화면이 있으니까 정말 놀라운 경험이었어.

sentences.en: You have amazing sound.
sentences.ko: 음향도 엄청나고.

sentences.en: And I really enjoyed it!
sentences.ko: 정말 재밌었어!

sentences.en: I've not actually been to the cinema for maybe two years, I think.
sentences.ko: 나는 사실 영화관에 안 간 지 2년쯤 된 것 같아.

sentences.en: Wow, Phil! Why don't you go to the cinema?
sentences.ko: 와, 필! 왜 영화관에 안 가?

sentences.en: Do you not like it?
sentences.ko: 영화관 안 좋아해?

sentences.en: I like... I like the cinema as an event, so the last time I went, I went with my kids.
sentences.ko: 좋아해... 하나의 이벤트로서는 좋아해. 그래서 마지막으로 갔을 때는 아이들이랑 갔어.

sentences.en: I can't remember what film, but it was a big thing for them to go and they were excited about it, but I don't know...
sentences.ko: 무슨 영화였는지는 기억 안 나지만, 아이들한테는 큰 이벤트라서 엄청 신나 했어. 그런데 잘 모르겠어...

sentences.en: I like the big screen.
sentences.ko: 큰 화면은 좋아.

sentences.en: I like the sound.
sentences.ko: 음향도 좋아.

sentences.en: I like the event.
sentences.ko: 이벤트 같은 느낌도 좋고.

sentences.en: But if you want to spend time with people, I think in a cinema you can't talk to anyone.
sentences.ko: 그런데 사람들이랑 시간을 보내고 싶을 때, 영화관에서는 아무하고도 얘기를 못 하잖아.

sentences.en: You sit in the dark.
sentences.ko: 어두운 데 앉아 있고.

sentences.en: You can't talk.
sentences.ko: 말을 할 수 없지.

sentences.en: And it's not the best when you want to talk to people, when you want to get to know people, so I tend to watch films more at home, to be honest.
sentences.ko: 사람들이랑 얘기하고 싶을 때, 서로 알아가고 싶을 때는 별로야. 그래서 솔직히 말하면 영화는 집에서 더 많이 보는 편이야.

sentences.en: Yeah, but what about if you go to the cinema with people that you see very often and you don't need to catch up or find out about their lives?
sentences.ko: 응, 그런데 자주 만나서 근황을 나눌 필요가 없는 사람들이랑 영화관에 가는 건 어때?

sentences.en: You're just going to watch a film and to relax.
sentences.ko: 그냥 영화 보고 쉬러 가는 거지.

sentences.en: Yeah. I mean, yeah, that makes sense because it is...
sentences.ko: 응. 그건, 그래, 말이 되네. 왜냐하면...

sentences.en: it is nice to get out.
sentences.ko: 밖에 나가는 건 좋으니까.

sentences.en: It is nice to get out of the house and see it on a big screen.
sentences.ko: 집 밖에 나가서 큰 화면으로 보는 건 좋지.

sentences.en: There are also other downsides to going to the cinema.
sentences.ko: 영화관에 가는 데는 다른 단점들도 있어.

sentences.en: My big thing with the cinema is that the seats are not very comfortable.
sentences.ko: 나한테 영화관의 제일 큰 문제는 좌석이 별로 편하지 않다는 거야.

sentences.en: It's much more comfortable to watch a film at home because you might have a sofa, blankets – you can lie down.
sentences.ko: 집에서 영화를 보는 게 훨씬 편해. 소파도 있고 담요도 있고, 누울 수도 있잖아.

sentences.en: You don't have to sit like we are now in a chair upright.
sentences.ko: 지금 우리처럼 의자에 똑바로 앉아 있을 필요가 없지.

sentences.en: Yeah, it's really nice at home.
sentences.ko: 응, 집이 정말 좋아.

sentences.en: You have your snacks.
sentences.ko: 간식도 있고.

sentences.en: You don't have to pay for them as well.
sentences.ko: 간식값을 낼 필요도 없고.

sentences.en: I also think TVs that people have at home now are much better than they used to be.
sentences.ko: 그리고 요즘 사람들이 집에 두는 TV가 예전보다 훨씬 좋아진 것 같아.

sentences.en: When I was a kid, you had a tiny little TV and it was so different to watching something at the cinema.
sentences.ko: 내가 어렸을 땐 TV가 아주 작아서 영화관에서 보는 거랑 완전히 달랐어.

sentences.en: But now I've got quite a nice telly.
sentences.ko: 그런데 지금은 꽤 좋은 TV가 있어.

sentences.en: So, Phil, you talked about going to the cinema as, like, an event.
sentences.ko: 필, 영화관에 가는 걸 이벤트 같은 거라고 했잖아.

sentences.en: So, something we do for special occasions.
sentences.ko: 그러니까 특별한 날에 하는 거.

sentences.en: I really feel that.
sentences.ko: 정말 공감해.

sentences.en: I love going to the cinema because you can buy snacks that you wouldn't normally eat.
sentences.ko: 나는 평소엔 안 먹는 간식을 살 수 있어서 영화관 가는 게 너무 좋아.

sentences.en: Like, popcorn is something I don't eat at home, but I eat at the cinema.
sentences.ko: 팝콘 같은 건 집에서는 안 먹는데 영화관에서는 먹어.

sentences.en: And then going in a little bit early and watching the film trailers, which are short adverts for films that are coming up soon that are shown at the cinema.
sentences.ko: 그리고 조금 일찍 들어가서 예고편을 보는 것도 좋아. 예고편(trailers)은 영화관에서 보여주는, 곧 개봉할 영화의 짧은 광고야.

sentences.en: Is there anything else you like about the cinema?
sentences.ko: 영화관에서 또 좋아하는 건 없어?

sentences.en: What is nice about the cinema is that you can have no distractions.
sentences.ko: 영화관의 좋은 점은 방해 요소가 없다는 거야.

sentences.en: You just have the film.
sentences.ko: 영화만 있는 거지.

sentences.en: You put your phone away.
sentences.ko: 휴대폰은 치워 두고.

sentences.en: At least you should put your phone away!
sentences.ko: 적어도 휴대폰은 치워 둬야 하지!

sentences.en: Some people...
sentences.ko: 어떤 사람들은...

sentences.en: some people in the cinema don't follow the rules, but hopefully everyone watching puts their phone away.
sentences.ko: 영화관에서 규칙을 안 지키는 사람들도 있지만, 보는 사람 모두 휴대폰을 치워 두길 바라.

sentences.en: There's no distractions.
sentences.ko: 방해 요소가 없어.

sentences.en: You can just relax and get involved in the film.
sentences.ko: 그냥 편하게 영화에 빠져들 수 있어.

sentences.en: It's really nice. It is really annoying when people in front of you or next to you are talking really loudly throughout the film.
sentences.ko: 정말 좋아. 앞이나 옆에 앉은 사람이 영화 내내 크게 떠들면 정말 짜증 나.

sentences.en: It's OK to whisper.
sentences.ko: 속삭이는 건 괜찮아.

sentences.en: So, that's when you whisper like that.
sentences.ko: 그러니까 이렇게 속삭이는 거.

sentences.en: It's OK to do that every now and again, but if they're talking all the way through the film, that is really annoying.
sentences.ko: 가끔 그러는 건 괜찮은데, 영화 내내 떠들면 정말 짜증 나.

sentences.en: Yeah, I can't stand that.
sentences.ko: 응, 그건 못 참겠어.

sentences.en: Phil, what kind of films do you like to watch at the cinema?
sentences.ko: 필, 영화관에서는 어떤 영화를 보고 싶어?

sentences.en: I think a film that takes you to a different place.
sentences.ko: 다른 곳으로 데려가 주는 영화인 것 같아.

sentences.en: So, something that's quite spectacular – there's a lot happening.
sentences.ko: 그러니까 꽤 장관이고 많은 일이 벌어지는 거.

sentences.en: There's a lot to see.
sentences.ko: 볼 게 많은 거.

sentences.en: Or maybe a film that shows you a bit of the world that's interesting that you don't know that well.
sentences.ko: 아니면 잘 모르는 흥미로운 세상의 한 부분을 보여주는 영화.

sentences.en: I kind of like films like that – films that take you somewhere, that show you something you wouldn't normally see.
sentences.ko: 그런 영화를 좋아하는 편이야. 어딘가로 데려가 주고, 평소에는 볼 수 없는 걸 보여주는 영화.

sentences.en: That's definitely good to watch on a big screen.
sentences.ko: 그런 건 확실히 큰 화면으로 보면 좋지.

sentences.en: Yeah, I agree.
sentences.ko: 응, 동의해.

sentences.en: I wouldn't go to the cinema to watch a romantic comedy, a romcom.
sentences.ko: 로맨틱 코미디, 그러니까 '롬콤'을 보러 영화관에 가진 않을 것 같아.

sentences.en: I agree with you.
sentences.ko: 나도 동의해.

sentences.en: I'd like to watch something, yeah, spectacular.
sentences.ko: 나는 그래, 장관인 걸 보고 싶어.

sentences.en: OK. Phil, it's time to look at some of the vocabulary we heard in this conversation, starting with 'trailers', which are short adverts for new films shown at the cinema.
sentences.ko: 좋아. 필, 이번 대화에서 들은 어휘를 살펴볼 시간이야. 먼저 'trailers'는 영화관에서 보여주는 새 영화의 짧은 광고야.

sentences.en: And we also talked about popcorn.
sentences.ko: 그리고 팝콘 얘기도 했지.

sentences.en: Now, popcorn – it's a snack.
sentences.ko: 팝콘은 간식이야.

sentences.en: It's made of corn, and it's usually either sweet or salty, and it's very nice and you get it at the cinema.
sentences.ko: 옥수수로 만들고, 보통 달거나 짭짤한데, 아주 맛있고 영화관에서 사 먹지.

sentences.en: We also heard 'spectacular', which is a very strong adjective to describe something that is very exciting to look at.
sentences.ko: 'spectacular'도 들었는데, 보기에 아주 신나는 것을 묘사하는 아주 강한 형용사야.

sentences.en: And we talked about 'distractions'.
sentences.ko: 그리고 'distractions'에 대해서도 얘기했지.

sentences.en: Things that are distractions are things that make you look at something you might not have wanted to look at, like someone's phone screen instead of the film.
sentences.ko: 'distractions'는 영화 대신 누군가의 휴대폰 화면처럼, 보고 싶지 않았던 걸 보게 만드는 것들이야.

sentences.en: And the things that you watch in the cinema are called 'films', or sometimes called 'movies' as well.
sentences.ko: 그리고 영화관에서 보는 건 'films'라고 하고, 'movies'라고도 해.

sentences.en: OK. And that's it for this week's episode of Real Easy English, but don't worry – we'll be back next week with another episode in easy English.
sentences.ko: 좋아. 이번 주 Real Easy English는 여기까지예요. 걱정 마세요, 다음 주에 쉬운 영어로 된 새 에피소드로 돌아올게요.

sentences.en: And don't forget to download a free worksheet to test what you've learned at bbclearningenglish.com.
sentences.ko: 그리고 bbclearningenglish.com에서 배운 걸 테스트할 수 있는 무료 워크시트도 꼭 받아 가세요.

sentences.en: Goodbye for now.
sentences.ko: 그럼 이만.

sentences.en: Bye.
sentences.ko: 안녕.
